item.tib: dbal phur gsang ba yang snying dbal nag khro rgyud kyis 'phrin las
item.coloph: dbal phur gsang ba yang snying zhes bya ba/ gting rdzogs gsang ba'i yang bcud/ dbal bon stag la me 'bar gyis las kyis srin po bsgral ba'i don du/ dbal gyi brag phug rong chen du bsgrub (bsgrubs) cing / des 'khros pa khrag gdong dmar po la brgyud/ khrag gdong gis dran pa la bshad/ dbal phur gsang rgyud las brgyud te (de) / dbang po yang rab 'bring tha gsum gyi don du byung nas/ gting rdzogs dbang po rab kyi don du phyung ste/ spa gro stag tshang du sbas nas khu tsha dang mgar ston la smon lam btab bo/ 'di ni dbang po 'bring gis (gi) don du phyung te (ste) dran pa'i (pas) pom ra'i thugs kar gter la sbas/ cig ((gcig) ni dbang po tha ma'i don du phyung te (ste)phyi rab (rabs) kyi bon gshen rnams la shin tu nyer 'grub kyi lta ba thugs la gab nas sprul sku dbra ston nam mkha' rin chen la babs pa'o/ (mchan 'dir bka' rtags yod) ces pa'i kho bo dbra khyung pa g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal gsang mtshan stag chung dbal 'bar stag slag can bdag la dngos grub tu babs pa/ spre'u zhes pa me mo lug gi lo hor zla 6tshes 10la/ dpal gyi gdan sa khyung nag pho brang du gtan la phab cing drung yig pa ni bsngags (sngags) nag pa she tsu ming gis zhal bshus pa lags so// (mchan 'dir bka' rtags yod/)bka' rtags mi 'gyur bcu gsum gyi rgya gdab pa lags so//
